description: This stacked bar chart illustrates the number of experts assigned to each of 24 layers, categorized into two groups, G1 (green) and G2 (orange), with a blue segment representing an additional category as indicated by the legend, though its label is obscured. The horizontal axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 1 to 24 in sequential order, while the vertical axis, labeled "Number of Experts," scales linearly from 0 to 10, with major gridlines and tick marks at integer intervals. Each bar corresponds to a layer and is composed of stacked segments: the bottom segment is blue, the middle segment is green (G1), and the top segment is orange (G2). The height of each bar represents the total number of experts for that layer, with values ranging from a minimum of 3 experts (layer 7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 23, 24) to a maximum of 9 experts (layer 1). The chart does not indicate any sorting of the bars by value or any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding beyond the standard color coding for the groups.
